summary: Resolve QA V3 citation references and percentage arithmetic locally instead of requiring the provider to duplicate exact source text and metadata.
decision_refs: The first lean-contract DeepSeek Flash rerun produced five citation-scope failures, one answer-union failure and two calculation failures on the frozen 15-question evidence set
Every source atom in the frozen run is within the existing canonical citation quote bound, so CIRP can safely copy the exact prompt-visible atom after validating its evidence ID
The approved ponytail direction favors deleting redundant model-authored fields instead of adding another orchestration layer
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested continued implementation, testing and iteration after approving the minimal development plan.
known_limitations: Evidence-reference compilation removes copying errors but does not prove that the selected evidence is relevant or that every requested field was answered.
Percentage arithmetic is limited to one cited base and one cited percentage; unit conversion, rounding, date arithmetic, image arithmetic and geometry remain unsupported.
Rejected provider output remains intentionally unavailable, so historical contract failures can be classified but not repaired in place.
No live provider call is part of this implementation change; a later frozen evaluation is a separate operational validation.
